annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint is permitted to resend previously sent data as a probe packet if no new data is available.

annotation.justification: The use of "MAY" creates ambiguity regarding whether resending previously sent data is optional or permissible. It is unclear if the endpoint *must* send *something* as a probe, or if it can simply omit the probe packet if no new data is available.
